Adding 358 days to 1360-10-06:  
1360 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules as instructed).  
From Oct 6, remaining days in 1360: 31-6=25 (Oct) + 30 (Nov) + 31 (Dec) = 86 days.  
358 - 86 = 272 days into 1361.  
Jan 31, Feb 28 (1361 not leap), Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days.  
272 - 243 = 29 days into September → 1361-09-29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1361-09-29
